[[Mahalo Trail]] }}'''The Decision and the Tournament of Six''' (Japanese: '''決定！！６人トーナメント！''' ''Decision!! 6-Person Tournament!'') is the fourth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Sun, Moon, Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon}} of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga. ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== {{spoilers}} * {{adv|Sun}} and {{adv|Moon}} arrive at [[Iki Town]], where the festival commences. * Moon is enlisted by [[Olivia]] to help decide the placement of the [[Iki Town festival tournament|tournament]] entrees. * Moon meets [[Lillie]]. * Lillie's {{p|Cosmog}}, [[Nebby]], runs off, forcing Moon, Lillie, and Olivia to chase after it to [[Mahalo Trail]]. * Moon discovers a strange [[Ultra Wormhole|crack in the sky]]. * Moon saves Nebby from a flock of wild {{p|Spearow}}, but Nebby causes the bridge they were standing on to be destroyed. * Moon and Nebby are saved by {{p|Tapu Koko}}. * After learning that Lillie was entered in the tournament as a mistake, Moon decides to take her place instead. * The final participant in the tournament is revealed to be [[Gladion]]. * Sun starts his battle against the [[Professor Kukui|Masked Royal]]. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * [[Samson Oak]] * [[Lillie]] * [[Hau]] * [[Gladion]] * [[Professor Burnet]] ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Rockruff}} * {{p|Yungoos}} * {{p|Rattata}} ([[Alolan form]]) * {{p|Grimer}} ([[Alolan form]]) * {{p|Marowak}} ([[Alolan form]]) * {{p|Cosmog}} ([[Nebby]];
